workData.title: Voice Interface for My Second Brain
workData.description: A voice-driven interface that turns natural speech into structured tasks, projects, events, and notes inside a customized Obsidian knowledge system.
problem: My Obsidian system already organized projects, tasks, events, notes, and daily information—but adding something still required opening the application, navigating to the right place, and entering the correct metadata.
I wanted the system to understand intent without requiring the interface.
solution: I built a voice layer that accepts natural speech, transcribes it, identifies the user's intent, and converts it into structured Markdown.
The system determines whether the input is a task, event, project, note, or other supported object and applies the appropriate metadata, template, folder, and date information.
The resulting item appears inside the existing Obsidian system without requiring manual organization.
howItWorks: **Example:** Spoken input — "Add Toyota interview Tuesday at 9 AM." The system identifies the event, extracts the date and time, generates the structured entry, and places it into the appropriate workflow.

workData.title: Multilingual Collaboration System
workData.description: A shared workspace where English and Japanese users can work on the same content in their own languages while changes remain synchronized.
problem: Traditional translation workflows create separate copies of the same information.
When one side edits the English version, the Japanese version can quickly become outdated—and vice versa. That creates duplicated work and makes multilingual collaboration difficult.
solution: I built a multilingual collaboration system where English and Japanese users interact with the same underlying content while viewing and editing it in their preferred language.
Changes are synchronized so the system behaves like one shared workspace rather than two translated documents.
The goal was not simply translation. It was designing collaboration around the reality that participants may not share the same language.

workData.title: Local-AI Document Pipeline
workData.description: A document-processing workflow that turns captured paperwork into organized knowledge, extracting tasks, deadlines, metadata, and useful information automatically.
problem: Important information arrives through paperwork, screenshots, PDFs, receipts, forms, and other documents.
Capturing the document is easy. Turning it into something searchable and actionable is not.
solution: I built a workflow connecting mobile document capture with a local AI processing system and desktop knowledge base.
Documents are processed, classified, and converted into structured information.
The pipeline can identify useful metadata, extract tasks and deadlines, assign tags, and route the resulting Markdown into the appropriate location in the knowledge system.
howItWorks: **Workflow:** Capture → OCR / extraction → classification → structured data → tasks / deadlines → Markdown → knowledge base

workData.title: Your Second Brain, Always Visible
workData.description: A calm, always-on interface that turns information from my Obsidian knowledge system into glanceable screens for tasks, projects, events, notes, and daily context.
problem: My tasks, calendar, projects, notes, and other useful information already existed digitally—but seeing them meant opening an application and actively looking for them.
I wanted important information to remain visible without another screen demanding attention.
solution: I connected my Obsidian knowledge system to an e-ink display.
A custom service reads structured Markdown and other data sources, determines what should be displayed, renders display-ready screens, and sends them to the device.
Different views can surface tasks, calendar information, projects, notes, highlights, meal planning, and other context.
howItWorks: **Design principle:** Inform, don't interrupt. The display is intentionally quiet. It provides ambient awareness without notifications, app switching, or another bright screen.

workData.title: Comic-to-Video Production Tool
workData.client: Creative Technology · Timeline UI · Keyframes · Automation
workData.description: A production interface for turning layered comic artwork into motion content using timeline editing, camera keyframes, and repeatable batch workflows.
problem: Turning static comic artwork into video requires repetitive editing: positioning artwork, creating camera movement, timing scenes, and repeating the process across many panels.
General-purpose video editors can do this, but the workflow is unnecessarily manual for comic-based content.
solution: I developed a purpose-built production tool for converting layered comic artwork into video.
The interface provides timeline editing, camera keyframes, layered asset control, and repeatable workflows designed specifically around comic production.

workData.title: 34-Site Deployment System
workData.description: A deployment system that lets me manage dozens of independent project websites without manually configuring hosting, DNS, repositories, and deployments for each one.
problem: Maintaining dozens of small project and portfolio sites creates repetitive infrastructure work.
Every new site normally requires repository setup, deployment configuration, DNS records, subdomains, and ongoing maintenance.
solution: The system builds, exports, deploys, and manages 34 independent websites across GitHub and Cloudflare.
Each project remains independently version-controlled and mapped to its own subdomain while shared automation handles repetitive deployment work.

workData.title: Cross-Device Automation System
workData.description: Built a personal automation ecosystem spanning Mac, iOS, and terminal environments. Unified Raycast scripts, Obsidian workflows, and shell aliases into a consistent, context-aware productivity layer that reduces friction across development, writing, and research tasks.

workData.title: Messaging Sticker Conversion
workData.description: Engineered a batch processing pipeline to extract, convert, and package messaging sticker assets across multiple formats and platforms. The tool automates frame extraction, transparency normalization, and export to APNG/WebP formats compatible with LINE, WhatsApp, and Telegram.

workData.title: AI Multilingual Learning System
workData.description: Created an AI-assisted language learning pipeline that classifies vocabulary and grammar items using LLMs, generates context-rich flashcard content, and pipes structured output into Anki decks. The system supports English, Japanese, and Farsi learning tracks.

workData.title: Deterministic Comic Coloring Engine
workData.description: A visual-processing system for producing repeatable, style-consistent comic coloring without relying entirely on generative AI.
problem: Generative image workflows can produce inconsistent colors, character details, and visual styles across sequential artwork.
solution: A deterministic processing system designed around repeatability and style consistency, supplemented by AI where useful.

workData.title: Extending Obsidian Into a Personal Operating System
workData.description: Custom extensions that turn Obsidian's structured data into calendars, project views, habit tracking, meal planning, and faster content creation.
